text.p: Chrysler Corp said Wednesday it produced 265,067 cars and light trucks worldwide in February, an increase of nearly seven percent over 248,063 for the same month a year ago.
Car production for February rose 10 percent to 78,451. Total truck production was 186,616, up 5.5 percent from February of 1996.
Total production from the U.S. and Canada was 225,797, versus 210,862. Mexico production for the month was 30,703, compared to 30,148 a year ago.
In Austria, where Chrysler makes Grand Cherokee sport utility vehicles and Voyager minivans, Chrysler produced 8,567 vehicles in February, up from 7,053 last year.
On a calendar year basis, Chrysler has produced 509,531 units so far in 1997, versus 478,152 for the same period of 1996.
